courtyard.flags: Eight irregular courses with varied spacing and selected edge splits

face: Single continuous anatomical relief field: closed curved lids, recessed orbits, arched brow, tapered nasal bridge/alar wings, malar planes, philtrum, separated lips and broadened jaw. Low-frequency asymmetry is geometry; albedo is not displacement. Embedded in three irregular shrine courses with finer flowing carving.
roots: Authored branching Catmull–Rom paths, elliptical tapered sections, longitudinal carved furrows and buttress flares.
planting: Seeded irregular fern beds with three height/spread forms and smaller folded evergreen leaves. Forty shallow curved groundcover cutouts use an independently authored 512px ivy/moss map outside the playable rectangle; they replace the small modeled ivy scatter. Roots, banks, ferns and stone retain actual silhouette and depth.
uv: Ordinary UV0: world-projected stone; longitudinal bark; full 0..1 padded fern frond; channel-local water.
authorship: Deterministically authored geometry; no image-derived displacement, baked cards, UI or painted-perspective scenery.
